periodicAtlasGeneration.purpose: 2026-09-22 seam-safe replacement: imagegen made isolated motifs only; the deterministic compositor owns periodic placement and edge wrapping. The original sources remain preserved as historical masters.
periodicAtlasGeneration.composition: Dense irregular mix of medium theme motifs and tiny shared accents. Placement tests actual alpha contours with three-pixel clearance on a toroidal occupancy map, preserving detail and interleaving transparent corners without touching ink. Independently composed 3x3 proofs must exactly match the repeated tile, including all edges and corners.
periodicAtlasGeneration.atlasLayout: Four by four isolated complete motifs in transparent RGBA. Detect actual transparent row gutters and per-row column gutters near quarter boundaries, rejecting cut motifs. Alpha threshold 2%; each retained cutout includes a three-pixel alpha fringe.
